facts.statement: Free Realms began appearing in a television spot, which was also viewable on the freerealms.com news page.
facts.quote: Starting today you may be seeing Free Realms on your television, but you can also check it out right here!

article_summaries.title: It's Your World TV Spot
article_summaries.summary: A short official freerealms.com news post announcing that Free Realms had begun airing as a television spot, with a link to view the spot on the website. The page gives no details of the ad's content, length, or channels, and no game mechanics. The capture date is 2009-05-14, and the post itself says it was posted 5 days and 11 hours before capture.
